//TR: Factory V2 görev kaydı: V4.1 matrisinde bulunmayan Factory V2 işlerinin elle yazılan, Founder onaylı kaynağıdır. build-task-index.mjs bu dosyayı matrisle birleştirip task-index.json'u üretir; task-index.json elle düzenlenmez. Yeni FV2 görevi yalnız bu dosyaya Founder-tier governance PR'ı ile eklenir. Teslim edilmiş bir görevin düzeltmesi aynı görev kimliğini kullanır.
rules: A task id is never reused, renamed or moved to other work; retired tasks stay listed with a terminal status.

tier is set by the real risk and authority scope (V4.1 roadmap section 2): T3 for anything that changes merge/dispatch authority, CI-executed review or reviewer credentials; T2 for supervisor, ledger, identity, security-enforcing or model-routing code; T1 for low-risk code and tests.
status VERIFY_PENDING = implemented in an open PR and not yet merged: never picked as new work by V4.1 or the V2 scheduler, still mergeable.
deps are typed [taskId, "MERGED"] and are met only by a merged task (matrix DONE status or a verified STATE.json done entry).
